newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up amid fresh commitments.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up amid fresh commitments.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed up in a rally for a fourth straight session with fresh commitments from retail investors, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index closed 90.7 points, or 4.9 percent, higher at 1,938.47 on a turnover of 144.5 million taka. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh. Of 109 traded issues 86 gained and 22 lost.

"The retail investors regain their confidence as most of the scrips have started rising for the last couple of sessions," said one broker. Bangladesh Lamps gained 112 taka to 6,609, Shine Pukur rose 25 to 316 and Square Pharma was up 13 to 1,470.
